top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
top_sast_rules.description: A remote user-controlled data can reach a costly Unicode normalization with either form NFKC or NFKD. On Windows OS, with an attack such as the One Million Unicode Characters, this could lead to a denial of service. And, with the use of special Unicode characters, like U+2100 (℀) or U+2105 (℅), the payload size could be tripled.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement resource consumption limits, rate limiting, and proper cleanup mechanisms for all operations.
